description: Routing set for multi-product chat (#2336, Part A): which projects hold the answer to a question asked over a scope of up to nine products. The first two are the Acme Reader products of questions.json; the other seven are distractors from other eval corpora: the three fixture-portfolio repositories (localization-02) and four synthetic requirement documents (docunderstanding-01 to -04), each its own project. Each product carries the one-line description and tags a project admin would curate. A question taken from questions.json ('from') answers from the products its expected sources name; the others list them in 'answerIn'. An empty 'answerIn' is a question no product answers: the router should fall back to searching every project.
authoredBy: agent (issue #2336); the answerIn labels of the from-questions are derived from questions.json's expected sources; not yet reviewed by a person

Which event does the billing service listen for before it creates an invoice?
